scripts.format: biome format --write package.json packages application/src application/package.json web/src web/community web/scripts web/package.json test-addon --files-ignore-unknown=true
scripts.lint: biome lint package.json packages application/src application/package.json web/src web/community web/scripts web/package.json test-addon --files-ignore-unknown=true
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter './packages/*' build && bun run --filter '*' typecheck
